process_observation: Own leader return/wall observation; cancellation independently attempts group signal and bounded leader reap. The exact first exception is re-raised; raw secondary errors are retained on HostRuntime.last_failure. No group-completion certification or complete descendant/whole-campaign/resource/isolation guarantee.
public_boundary: No candidate program runner/default program condition. Full grade/support/mouse identities and command plans remain operator-private.

routes.grade: Invoke original operator grade.py with root,binding,submission,output. Inherited core validates every submitted pair before its private loader.
routes.inspect: Complete ordinary source authentication and method report.
routes.plan_grade: Validate closed request; authenticate24method roles; construct exact inherited grade.py CLI. Read no requested binding/submission/targets.
routes.plan_prepare: Validate closed request; authenticate24method roles; construct exact inherited prepare.py CLI. Read no requested input.
routes.prepare: Invoke original prepare.py in a separate -I -B Python process with full source-root/index hash/fresh-output arguments.

source_authentication: Exact24role hash census and finite directories; scientific implementation bodies unchanged, with explicit provenance-only metadata projection. Source authentication is not immutable-storage or native environment qualification.
trust_boundary: Operator-only API. The caller must already own authentic source/binding/target custody and execution authority. Path strings and source hashes do not issue that authority.

fixed_warp.boundary: Use postreward branch at t=2; both branches give1s continuously.
fixed_warp.formula: mu1(g(t)); g(t)=t/2 for0<=t<2 and g(t)=t-1 for2<=t<=3
fixed_warp.support: Compute mean on candidate-visible source grid0..3s, then linearly interpolate within that grid; identical query grid0..3s and all registered cells/trials for both comparators.

primary.aggregation: Preserve pooled pair RMSE/training-scale ratio exactly: equal cells/trials/times inside each pair MSE and pooled scale, then equal pair NRMSEs within mouse and equal mice. This is not the mean of per-cell NRMSEs. Recurrent components can receive repeated weight through pairs.
primary.name: mouse_macro_training_scale_NRMSE
primary.per_pair: sqrt(mean((prediction-target)^2 over querytrials, registeredcells,61times)/mean((train-train_cell_mean)^2 over all publicsource trials,cells,times))
primary.train_cell_mean: per-cell mean over allpublic1s trials andtimebins
primary.zero_training_scale: undefined full primary; no epsilon or favorable subset

unchanged_semantics.support: Raw projection v2 preserves every source-session structural disposition and every oriented registration row, including zero-sided rows. Every required selected pair must pass or preparation refuses; no unsupported pair is silently dropped.
unchanged_semantics.undefined: undefined full primary; no epsilon or favorable subset
